title: 诺德斯特龙私有化：摆脱季度盯盘后专注度提升，专注度提升能否换来更好经营？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: As I think about it, I don't know that it's really changed much for the thousands of people that work here or even for customers and how they interact with us, but particularly for my brother Eric and myself and my cousin Jamie,
segments.zh: 回想起来，我不确定这对在这里工作的数千名员工，甚至对客户以及他们与我们的互动方式有多大改变，但特别是对我兄弟埃里克、我自己和表弟杰米来说，

segments.en: it's changed how we do our job and for the better. And I'd say that's mostly around the ability to create focus now,
segments.zh: 它改变了我们的工作方式，而且是往好的方向。我想说，这主要是因为我们能够集中精力，

segments.en: around really the business and not all the trappings that go with being a public company.
segments.zh: 真正专注于业务，而不是上市公司带来的所有繁琐事务。

segments.en: You know, that's all we really knew was a public company and it was fine, but when you don't have those obligations anymore, you start recognizing how much time and clarity that provides for doing the business, you know, hopefully differently and better.
segments.zh: 你知道，我们过去只知道上市公司这一种模式，那也不错，但当你不再有那些义务时，你开始意识到这为经营业务提供了多少时间和清晰度，你知道，希望能以不同且更好的方式去做。

segments.en: So that focus has helped us for sure. Well, I mean obviously being public, I mean it comes obviously with the baggage of having Wall Street looking over your shoulder every three months and probably even more frequently than that.
segments.zh: 所以这种专注肯定帮助了我们。嗯，我的意思是，显然作为上市公司，它伴随着华尔街每三个月甚至更频繁地审视你的负担。

segments.en: So going private, did that give you the opportunity to do things that Wall Street would not have allowed you to do?
segments.zh: 那么私有化是否给了你机会去做华尔街不允许你做的事情？

segments.en: It's not really so much that it's, you know, when you're a public company, your scoreboard is your stock price.
segments.zh: 其实并不完全是，你知道，当你是上市公司时，你的记分牌就是你的股价。

segments.en: And the stock price has a lot of variables and things that go into that that we don't necessarily have a ton of control over.
segments.zh: 而股价有很多变量和因素，我们不一定能完全控制。

segments.en: I mean your results obviously over time really affect that a lot, but it's also true that we're part of a sector of business that wasn't super highly valued.
segments.zh: 我的意思是，你的业绩显然会随着时间的推移对股价产生很大影响，但同样真实的是，我们所在的行业板块并没有得到很高的估值。

segments.en: It was super highly valued by the investing public and that impacts the multiple impacts to your stock price.
segments.zh: 它曾被**大众给予很高的估值，这影响了倍数，影响了你的股价。
